blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Structured clinical decisions from volumetric computed tomography (CT) require anatomically grounded predictions and calibrated confidence estimates. However, existing 3D medical multimodal models often suffer from uncalibrated autoregressive decoding and shortcut reliance on irrelevant anatomical regions. We introduce Radev, a decision-native multimodal model that integrates anatomy-guided visual compression, direct candidate prediction, and counterfactual confidence supervision. To bridge global context with fine-grained slice details, a frozen 3D encoder extracts reusable organ-level features, which are dynamically selected by the query to attend to 2D slice features within predicted anatomical bounds. The resulting compact visual tokens enable the language backbone to estimate candidate probabilities in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding. We further propose Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT) to compare predictions under intact and intervened organ representations. CCT encourages confidence to decrease when removing target-organ evidence degrades decision quality, while penalizing excessive confidence drops under unrelated-organ removal. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we construct CT-Verdict, a comprehensive benchmark spanning binary finding presence, multiple-choice questions, and ordinal severity assessment across both in-distribution and external cohorts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Radev significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both decision accuracy and confidence calibration, while generalizing robustly under distribution shifts. Project page at https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/
blocks.zh: 从量子计算成形法(CT)中作出结构化的临床决定,需要解剖基础的预测和校正信心估计。 然而,现有的3D医疗多模式往往受到无校正自旋解码和快捷方式依赖无关解剖区域的影响。 我们引入了Redev,一种决定内在的多模式模型,它结合了解剖学引导的视觉压缩,直接的候选预测,以及反事实信心监督. 为将全局上下文与精细的切片细节相接,被冷冻的3D编码器提取出可再使用的器官级特征,这些特征被查询动态地选中,用于处理预测解剖界限内的2D切片特征. 由此产生的紧凑的视觉符号使语言主干线能够在一次前行通行证中估算候选人的概率,而无需自动解码. 我们还提议进行反事实分析培训,以比较在完整和干预的机关表述下所作的预测。 CCT鼓励在去除目标器官证据时降低信心会降低决定质量,同时惩罚过度信任在去除无关器官后下降. 为了便利严格的评价,我们构建了CT-Verdict,一个涵盖二进制查找存在、多重选择问题和对分配和外部群体进行正常严重程度评估的全面基准。 广泛的实验表明,拉德夫在决策精确度和置信度校正方面都大大地超越了最先进的方法,同时在分配变化中普遍地强势地进行. 项目网页https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Generative VLMs vs. Decision-Native VLMs. Conventional generative VLMs are designed for open-ended reasoning and report generation, yet often rely on ungrounded visual context and yield uncalibrated confidence. Radev is a decision-native model tailored for structured, organ-grounded, and confidence-aware clinical judgment.
blocks.zh: 图1: Generative VLMs vs. decision-Native VLMs. 常规 Generative VLMs是为开阔的推理和报告生成而设计的,但往往依赖于无根据的视觉上下文,产生未校准的信心. 拉德夫是一个适合结构化,器官定位,以及自信的临床判断的决策本土模型.

blocks.en: Medical vision language models (VLMs) integrate visual inputs with natural-language queries to support diverse clinical tasks ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Qiu et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . In volumetric computed tomography (CT), clinical queries routinely target specific organs or findings to assess their presence, anatomical location, attributes, or severity. Because these judgments carry high clinical stakes, where missed findings delay intervention and false positives trigger unnecessary procedures, clinicians require reliable uncertainty estimates to flag ambiguous cases for human review ( Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ; Angelopoulos and Bates, 2023 ) . However, overconfident errors undermine this safety net by making erroneous predictions appear trustworthy. Achieving safe clinical deployment therefore demands not only high diagnostic accuracy, but also rigorous confidence calibration, ensuring that a model’s reported confidence faithfully reflects its empirical accuracy.
blocks.zh: 医学视觉语言模型(VLMs)将视觉输入与自然语言问询相结合,支持多种临床任务(江等人,2025;邱等人,2025;徐等人,2026b;袁等人,2026;李等人,2026a). 在量子计算成像法(CT)中,临床调查通常针对特定器官或结果,以评估其存在、解剖位置、属性或严重程度。 由于这些判断具有很高的临床利害关系,错失的发现延迟干预,假阳性引发不必要的程序,临床医生需要可靠的不确定性估计,以标出模棱两可的病例供人类审查(Geifman和El-Yaniv,2017年;Angelopoulos和Bates,2023年). 然而,过度自信的错误使错误的预测显得可信,从而破坏了这一安全网。 因此,实现安全的临床部署不仅需要高准确度的诊断,还需要严格的信心校准,确保模型报告的信心忠实地反映其经验准确性。

blocks.en: Existing volumetric CT VLMs predominantly follow a generative paradigm as shown in Fig. 1 , employing 3D or hybrid encoders to autoregressively generate free-text answers or radiology reports ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Xin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) . While these models can be adapted to closed-set clinical decisions via text generation or candidate likelihood scoring, this formulation faces three fundamental limitations. First, autoregressive decoding incurs unnecessary computational overhead for structured decisions and often yields poorly calibrated token-level probabilities. Second, detecting localized findings requires fine-grained 2D slice details situated within 3D organ context, where the relevant anatomical evidence shifts dynamically with the query. Third, standard answer-level supervision rewards agreement with ground-truth labels without verifying whether the prediction, or its confidence, is genuinely grounded in the target anatomy rather than spurious background correlations. Building on recent advances in decision modeling ( Typesafe.ai, 2025 ; Tang and Chen, 2026 ; Tommasino and Rinaldi, 2026 ) , we reformulate structured CT interpretation as a decision process as in Fig. 1 centered on direct candidate probability estimation, query-driven anatomical evidence selection, and counterfactual confidence supervision.
blocks.zh: 现有体积 CT VLMs主要遵循图1所示的基因模式,使用3D或混合编码器自动生成自由文本解答或放射学报告(Wu等人,2025年;Xin等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年b;袁等人,2026年). 虽然这些模型可以通过文本生成或候选概率评分来适应封闭式的临床决定,但这种配方面临三个基本限制. 首先,自动退缩的解码会造成结构化决定的不必要的计算间接费用,并往往产生不适当的符号级概率。 第二,探测局部性发现需要精细的2D切片细节,这些细节位于3D器官内,相关解剖证据随查询动态转移. 第三,标准答案层面的监督奖励与地面真实标签的协议,而不核实预测或其信心是否真正基于目标解剖,而不是虚假的背景关联。 在决策模型化(Typesafe.ai, 2025年;Tang and Chen, 2026年;Tommasino and Rinaldi, 2026年)的近期进展基础上, 我们重拟了结构化的CT解释作为决策程序, 如图1 , 其中心是直接候选人概率估计、查询驱动解剖证据选择以及反事实信任监督。

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce Radev , a decision-native multimodal model that unifies anatomically grounded visual compression with counterfactual confidence calibration. Specifically, Radev utilizes a frozen 3D encoder to extract reusable organ-level features, which are projected into a persistent organ ledger . Given a clinical query, a text-guided routing mechanism selects the target organs, whose tokens attend to high-resolution 2D slice features within predicted 3D anatomical bounds. The resulting compact visual token sequence preserves global organ context while injecting localized slice evidence specifically for the queried anatomy. Paired with the question and candidate options, these tokens allow the language backbone to estimate candidate probabilities in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding. Following multimodal alignment and verdict fine-tuning across binary, multiple-choice, and ordinal tasks, we introduce Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT). By contrasting model predictions under intact, target-ablated, and control-ablated organ representations, CCT explicitly forces confidence to drop when removing target-organ evidence impairs decision quality, while penalizing unwarranted sensitivity to the removal of unrelated organs.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了Redev,一种决定内在的多模式模型,通过反事实置信度校准统一解剖基础的视觉压缩. 特别是,Radev使用冷冻的3D编码器来提取可重复使用的器官层次特征,这些特征被投射到持久的器官分类账中。 根据临床的询问,文本导引的路由机制会选择目标器官,其标志在预测的3D解剖界限内处理高分辨率的2D切片特征. 由此产生的紧凑的视觉符号序列保留了全球器官的背景,同时专门为被询问的解剖学注入局部的切片证据。 带有问题和候选人选项的Paired,这些符号允许语言主干线在一次前行通行证中估算候选人的概率,而无需自动解码. 继多模式调整和判定微调跨二进制、多选择和普通任务之后,我们引入了反事实加分培训(CCT)。 通过对比模型预测在完好无损,目标拉伸,控制拉伸的器官表现下,CCT明确在移除目标器官证据时迫使信心下降会损害决定质量,同时惩罚对切除无关器官的不合理敏感性.

blocks.en: To enable rigorous evaluation, we construct CT-Verdict , a comprehensive benchmark for structured CT interpretation spanning binary finding presence, multiple-choice location and attribute queries, and ordinal severity assessment. Featuring both in-distribution (IID) and external test cohorts, CT-Verdict establishes a standardized testbed for evaluating accuracy and calibration across task types and distribution shifts. Extensive experiments show that Radev-2B achieves a state-of-the-art overall accuracy of 83.75 % 83.75\% on CT-Verdict-IID while substantially improving confidence calibration and out-of-distribution generalization. Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • Decision-Native Architecture: We propose Radev , a structured CT interpretation model that bridges reusable 3D organ ledgers with query-selected 2D slice evidence, enabling single-pass candidate probability estimation without autoregressive decoding. • Counterfactual Confidence Supervision: We design Counterfactual-Calibrated Training , an intervention-based training objective that aligns predictive confidence with causal anatomical evidence by contrasting intact, target-ablated, and control-ablated organ states. • Benchmark and Empirical Validation: We release CT-Verdict , a multi-task volumetric CT benchmark with internal and external cohorts, and demonstrate that Radev consistently outperforms existing generative VLMs in diagnostic accuracy, confidence calibration, and robustness to distribution shifts.
blocks.zh: 为了能够进行严格的评价,我们构建了CT-Verdict(CT-Verdict)这一综合基准,用于结构化的CT解释,涵盖二进制发现存在,多选择位置和属性查询,以及平面严重程度评估。 CT-Verdict在分配中和外部测试组同时设置一个标准测试台,用于评估不同任务类型和分布变化的准确性和校准。 广泛的实验表明,Redev-2B在CT-Verdict-IID上实现了83.75%83.75%的先进整体精度,同时大幅度改善了信心校准和分配外通用. 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出一个结构化的 CT 解释模型, 将3D器官分类账与 查询选择的 2D 切片证据连接起来, 使得单通过候选人概率估算 而不自动解码。 • 反事实信任监督: 我们设计了“反事实分析培训”,这是一个基于干预的培训目标,它将预测性信心与因果解剖证据联系起来,对比完好无损、目标缩小和控制性削弱的器官状态。 • 基准和经验验证: 我们释放了CT-Verdict(CT-Verdict),这是一个包含内外组群的多任务量性CT基准,并表明Radev在诊断准确性、信心校准和稳健性方面持续超越了现有的基因VLM。

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Decision Model
blocks.zh: 2.1 决定模式

blocks.en: Direct prediction over candidate answers has been explored in language and vision language modeling. BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) scores candidate continuations for multiple-choice inference, while LXMERT ( Tan and Bansal, 2019 ) predicts answers from a predefined vocabulary conditioned on an image and a question. These discriminative formulations provide an established basis for making decisions without free-text generation. Recent decision-native language models revisit this principle through interfaces that accept a task description and an explicit candidate set and return candidate probabilities. Jev ( Typesafe.ai, 2025 ) is one such system, mapping a typed state and discrete candidates to a decision distribution in a single forward pass. Open replicas fine-tune general-purpose backbones with decision heads or pointer readouts like Kev ( Palmer, 2026 ) , decider ( Marosi, 2026 ) , OneJev ( OmniJev Team, 2026 ) , ReJev ( Joe-rq, 2026 ) , which retain the autoregressive backbone but score candidates.
blocks.zh: 在语言和视觉语言模型方面,对候选人答案进行了直接预测。 BERT(Devlin等人,2019年)为多个选择推论评分候选人续作评分,而LXMERT(Tan and Bansal,2019年)则以一个图像和一个问题为条件的预设词汇预测答案. 这些歧视性的提法为在不产生自由文本的情况下作出决定提供了既定的基础。 最近的决定本土语言模型通过接受任务说明和明确候选人组合并返回候选人概率的接口,重新审视这一原则。 Jev(Typesafe.ai,2025年)是一个这样的系统,将一个打字状态和离散的候选者映射成一个单一前传的决定分配. 开放的复制品微调通用骨干,有决策头或指针读数,如Kev(Palmer,2026年),决定者(Marosi,2026年),OneJev(OmniJev Team,2026年),ReJev(Joe-rq,2026年),保留自动递归骨干但得分的候选人.

blocks.en: 2.2 Medical Vision Language Model
blocks.zh: 2.2 医学视觉语言模型

blocks.en: VLMs are now widely used in medical imaging, answering report generation and visual question-answering. The domain-specific nature of medical images has given medical VLMs a distinct set of design choices. One family retains standard 2D architectures. LLaVA-Med ( Li et al., 2023 ) establishes this paradigm via concept alignment and instruction tuning. HealthGPT ( Lin et al., 2025 ) introduces H-LoRA plugins to unify medical comprehension and generation. Despite these advances, their visual inductive bias remains 2D without volumetric supervision. Consequently, volumetric images like CT studies are reduced to 2D slices, a compromise formalized by Hulu-Med ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , which processes slices as patch sequence via rotary-position-adaptive encoding. To reduce inter-slice redundancy, CARVE ( Yi et al., 2026 ) frames training-free token compression as a budget-constrained 2.5D allocation problem to retain salient visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 目前VLM被广泛用于医学成像,回答报告生成和视觉问答. 医学影像的域特异性为医学VLM提供了一套独特的设计选择. 一个家族保留了标准的2D架构. LLaVA-Med(Li等人,2023年)通过概念对齐和指令调试建立了这一范式. HealthGPT(Lin等人,2025年)推出H-LORA插件,统一医学理解和生成. 尽管取得了这些进步,他们的视觉诱导偏差仍然是2D而不进行体积监督. 因此,像CT研究这样的体积图像被缩小为2D切片,这是由Hulu-Med(Jiang等人,2025年)正式形成的折衷方案,通过旋转位置适应编码将切片作为补丁序列处理. 为了减少剪切间冗余,CARVE(Yi等人,2026年)将无训练符号压缩作为预算限制的2.5D分配问题来保留显著的视觉证据.

blocks.en: A second family integrates 3D encoders, addressing two key bottlenecks: volumetric token explosion and the lack of web-scale 3D corpora. To tame token complexity, RadFM ( Wu et al., 2025 ) relies on interleaved 2D/3D generative pretraining, M3D-LaMed ( Bai et al., 2024 ) enforces a fixed token budget via a spatial-pooling perceiver, and Med3DVLM ( Xin et al., 2025 ) substitutes dense 3D attention with efficient decomposed convolutions. To compensate for data scarcity via rich supervision, CT-CHAT ( Hamamci et al., 2026 ) reuses a frozen CT-CLIP encoder, while Merlin ( Blankemeier et al., 2024 ) pretrains a 3D ResNet jointly on reports and EHR codes. Bridging both worlds, hybrid models retain 2D priors while injecting 3D cues modularly: OmniCT ( Lin et al., 2026b ) and TIF-GRPO ( Lin et al., 2026a ) combine 3D positional encodings with mask-guided organ token aggregation, and ClinFusion ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) fuses 3D volumes with 2D foundation features via local cross-attention. Despite these advances, decision VLMs tailored for 3D medical imaging remain largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: 第二家族整合了3D编码器,解决了两个关键瓶颈:音量令牌爆炸和缺乏网络尺度的3D公司. 为了驯服代号复杂,RadFM(Wu等人,2025年)依靠互离2D/3D基因前训练,M3D-LaMed(Bai等人,2024年)通过空间集合感应器执行固定代号预算,Med3DVLM(Xin等人,2025年)用高效的分解分解分解器取代密集的3D注意力. 为了通过丰富的监管来弥补数据稀缺,CT-CHAT(Hamamci等人,2026年)重新使用冷冻的CT-CLIP编码器,而Merlin(Blankemeier等人,2024年)则在报告和EHR代码上共同预留3D ResNet. 混合模型在连接两个世界时,保留2D前缀,同时以模块方式注入3D提示:OmniCT(Lin等人,2026b)和TIF-GRPO(Lin等人,2026a)将3D位置编码与面具导器官符号聚合结合,ClinFusion(Yuan等人,2026年)通过局部交叉注意将3D卷装有2D基础特征. 尽管取得了这些进展,但针对3D医疗成像的VLM决定仍然基本上没有得到探讨。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Framework of the proposed Radev. (a) The Organ-Grounded Visual Encoder uses organ masks and learned mask queries to extract 3D organ tokens. Question-selected organ tokens attend to 2D slice features within their anatomical bounds. The language backbone and candidate scoring head predict an answer distribution in a single forward pass. (b) Training proceeds through projector–evidence alignment, verdict fine-tuning, and Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT). (c) CCT constructs factual, target-ablated, control-ablated, and evidence-blind views by intervening on visual features. The first three views receive task supervision, while the evidence-blind view receives a confidence-margin penalty.

blocks.en: Radev combines an Organ-Grounded Visual Encoder with a Qwen3.5 language backbone and a candidate scoring head (Fig. 2 ). The encoder uses organ masks to guide 3D organ-token readout and region-restricted attention to incorporate question-relevant 2D slice evidence. Projector-evidence alignment and verdict fine-tuning (VFT) directly supervise candidate probabilities. Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT) then combines task supervision across intact and ablated representations with a confidence constraint on an evidence-blind view.

blocks.en: Supervision on intact inputs does not directly constrain confidence when anatomical evidence is withheld. Initialized from the VFT checkpoint, Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT) combines supervision across different evidence conditions with an explicit confidence constraint on an evidence-blind view.
blocks.zh: 在不提供解剖证据的情况下,对完整输入的监督并不直接限制信心。 从VFT检查站开始,反事实分析培训将不同证据条件的监督与对证据盲观点的明确信任限制结合起来。

blocks.en: Counterfactual views. CCT replaces the 3D features of selected slots with the shared missing-feature placeholder before the MLP in Eq. ( 2 ) and disables their 2D evidence updates. Each affected evidence token then reduces to its intervened ledger token, 𝐞 k = 𝐡 k \mathbf{e}_{k}=\mathbf{h}_{k} , preserving the interleaved token layout. For a volume V V and question q q mapped to organ set ℬ ⁡ ( q ) \mathcal{B}(q) , CCT evaluates four views sharing the same question text and gold answer. The factual view retains all extracted 3D features and 2D evidence updates. The target-ablated view replaces all bound organs in ℬ ⁡ ( q ) \mathcal{B}(q) together with the global slot n + 1 n{+}1 , while retaining unbound organs. The control-ablated view replaces one randomly sampled present organ outside ℬ ⁡ ( q ) ∪ { n + 1 } \mathcal{B}(q)\cup\{n{+}1\} and never ablates the global slot. The evidence-blind view replaces all n + 1 n{+}1 visual slots with placeholders and disables all 2D updates, removing every image-derived feature while preserving the placeholder token sequence. Infeasible target or control views fall back to factual readouts in the task average, whereas unbound questions still admit the evidence-blind view.

blocks.en: 4 CT-Verdict Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4 CT-验证基准

blocks.en: CT-Verdict pairs 3D CT volumes with structured clinical questions and candidate answers to evaluate decision performance on in-distribution and external data. It covers the three task types defined in Sec. 3.1 .
blocks.zh: CT-Verdict配对3D CT卷,并附有结构化的临床问题和候选答案,以评价关于分配和外部数据的决策性能. 它涵盖第3.1节界定的三种任务类型。

blocks.en: 4.1 Question Construction and Verification
blocks.zh: 4.1 问题建造和核查

blocks.en: Radiology reports are first parsed into structured finding records containing the finding, its associated organ or anatomical region, and its polarity, with optional attributes such as severity, size, number, laterality, and relations to neighboring structures. Fixed synthesis rules convert these records into question text, candidate sets, and reference labels. Binary questions use No/Yes answers, multiple-choice questions contain two to five candidates, and ordinal questions use five severity levels from 0 to 4.
blocks.zh: 放射学报告首先分为结构化的发现记录,包含发现,其相关器官或解剖区域,以及其极性,其可选属性如严重程度,大小,数量,后期,以及与邻国结构的关系等. 固定合成规则将这些记录转换成质疑文本,候选集,以及参考标签. 二进制问题使用No/Yes回答,多选题包含2至5名候选人,普通问题使用5个重度等级从0到4.

blocks.en: Two independent LLM readers answer each question using its source sentence, and their answers are compared with the rule-derived label. Disagreements are reviewed by a third reader. A random sample is additionally audited by a human reader. Questions that fail the reader-consistency criterion are discarded rather than relabeled. Question synthesis and label verification are separate stages, with the former determining the question text and reference labels and the latter checking their agreement with the source reports.
blocks.zh: 两个独立的LLM阅读器使用其源句回答每个问题,他们的答案与规则衍生的标签进行比较. 不同意见由第三读者审查。 随机抽样由人类阅读者额外审计. 未达到读者一致性标准的问题被抛弃而不是重新贴上标签。 问题综合和标签核查是单独的阶段,前者确定问题文本和参考标签,后者检查它们与来源报告的协议。

blocks.en: 4.2 Data Sources and Splits
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 数据源和分割

blocks.en: CT-Verdict-IID. Merlin-CT ( Blankemeier et al., 2024 ) supplies 25,270 contrast-enhanced and non-enhanced abdominal CT studies with paired reports for training and in-distribution evaluation. blocks.en: Model configuration. We instantiate the 3D branch with the frozen RADAR segmentation-and-encoding network ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , which is never trained on the source of CT-Verdict test set. blocks.en:
Main Results on CT-Verdict-IID. Table 1 compares Radev against representative general and decision-native VLMs across two readout modes. First, Radev establishes a decisive lead
across all three tasks: even our 2B variant achieves 83.75% overall accuracy,
outperforming the strongest open-source baselines, as 2D decision-native
models lack volumetric context and generative VLMs struggle with ordinal severity.
Closed-source models generalize better than open-source baselines yet still trail Radev
by ∼ \sim 19%, underscoring the necessity of domain-specific grounding. Beyond raw accuracy, a more critical requirement for clinical deployment is whether a model’s reported confidence is trustworthy. Even the most accurate open- and closed-source baselines remain severely overconfident and miscalibrated, confirming that task accuracy alone does not guarantee reliable uncertainty estimates. In contrast, Radev achieves the lowest Brier scores across all task families and drives top-label ECE down to the 0.01 ​ – ​ 0.02 0.01\text{--}0.02 range. This ensures that Radev’s predicted probabilities can be directly thresholded for selective prediction and clinical abstention.

blocks.en: 5.3 Confidence Analysis

blocks.en:
How reliable are the confidence estimates? A model can predict the correct answer while assigning an inaccurate
confidence score. We therefore evaluate whether its confidence agrees
with how often its predictions are correct.
Figure 3 summarizes two aspects of confidence quality.
Reliability error (REL) measures the gap between average confidence and
accuracy within confidence groups, with lower values indicating better
calibration. Resolution (RES) measures how much accuracy differs across
these groups. Together, these terms assess whether assigning different
confidence scores to individual predictions improves on simply reporting
the model’s overall accuracy for every prediction.
Under this evaluation, 14 of the 22 baselines perform worse than this
constant-confidence reference, whereas Radev achieves a positive Brier
skill score of 0.193 and a top-label ECE of 0.010. This reduces
calibration error by one to two orders of magnitude over the strongest baselines, demonstrating that Radev uniquely combines state-of-the-art
diagnostic accuracy with directly trustworthy confidence estimates.

blocks.en: Selective prediction via confidence-based rejection. Figure 4 demonstrates how confidence-based rejection turns Radev’s reported probabilities into an actionable clinical safety control. Deferring the least confident 20%, 40%, and 50% of cases to human readers steadily raises Radev-2B’s retained accuracy from 83.8% to 90.0%, 95.2%, and 97.0%. In contrast, no baseline matches this reliability at any deferral rate up to 90%: the strongest baseline (Jev-1.14) attains only 77.6% accuracy at 50% deferral. Because Radev’s accuracy–rejection curve is smooth, clinical workflows can select any operating point along the risk–workload frontier, allowing score autonomous verdicts and prioritize uncertain cases for clinician review.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Radev , a decision-native multimodal framework for structured 3D
abdominal CT interpretation, alongside the CT-Verdict benchmark. By coupling a
reusable 3D organ ledger with question-bound 2D slice evidence, Radev predicts
closed-set answer distributions in a single forward pass without autoregressive
decoding, while CCT anchors confidence in
anatomical evidence by contrasting intact, ablated, and evidence-blind views. Across
both CT-Verdict-IID and external CT-Verdict-OOD evaluations, Radev
achieves state-of-the-art diagnostic accuracy and calibration skill, delivering directly trustworthy probabilities for selective
prediction and clinical abstention. In
future work, we will extend the organ-grounded ledger and counterfactual calibration
framework to other volumetric imaging modalities, particularly multi-sequence MRI, as
well as broader anatomical regions.

blocks.en:
To ensure high label fidelity, candidate questions generated by our rule-based pipeline
undergo a strict multi-reader verification gate before release. As shown in

votes from the base readers are routed to a third adjudicating reader, and any item
failing to reach a two-of-three majority is discarded rather than relabeled. Following
verification, release-level filtering removes template-only statements and balances
option distributions, yielding the final released corpus of 280,111 questions for CT-Verdict-IID (223,286 training/validation and 56,825 test).

blocks.en: A.3 Details for Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: A.3 评价议定书的细节

blocks.en: We report per-question exact-match accuracy ( Acc ), macro-averaged balanced accuracy ( mBAcc ), and macro-averaged area under the ROC curve ( mAUC ). Both mBAcc and mAUC are first computed one-vs-rest within each disease category’s questions: mBAcc as the mean of sensitivity and specificity, and mAUC using the predicted probability (the “Yes” probability for binary, and the option probability for multiple-choice) against the one-vs-rest gold label. These scores are then macro-averaged across categories, specifically 30 clinical findings for binary and 26 option diseases for multiple-choice, to weight rare and common findings equally. The overall mBAcc averages the two branches per finding before macro-averaging. In contrast, mAUC is reported separately per branch because the two probability scales are incommensurate.
blocks.zh: 我们报告每个问题精确匹配的准确性(Acc),宏观平均均衡的准确性(mBAcc),以及ROC曲线下宏观平均的区域(mAUC). mBAcc 和 mAUC 都首先在每类疾病的问题中计算出一个-vs-resst : mBAcc作为灵敏度和特异性平均值,mAUC使用预测概率(二进制的“是”概率和多选制的概率)与一个-vs-res-rest金标签相对应。 这些分数然后按类别进行宏观平均,具体来说是二进制的30个临床发现和多选制的26个选择性疾病,以同等地衡量罕见和常见的发现。 总体mBAcc在宏观验证前平均每个发现的两个分支. 相比之下,mAUC因两个概率尺度不相称而单独报告每个分支.

Ordinal questions are evaluated using mean absolute error ( MAE ), normalized ranked probability score ( KRPS ) Epstein (1969) , and quadratic weighted kappa ( QWK ) Cohen (1968) .
KRPS compares the predicted and gold cumulative level distributions, KRPS i = 1 K − 1 ​ ∑ k = 1 K − 1 ( F ^ i ​ ( k ) − F i ​ ( k ) ) 2 , \mathrm{KRPS}_{i}\;=\;\frac{1}{K-1}\sum_{k=1}^{K-1}\bigl(\hat{F}_{i}(k)-F_{i}(k)\bigr)^{2}, (A1) penalizing probability mass on every incorrect level rather than only the argmax. It is omitted for unordered questions, which lack cumulative structure.
QWK discounts quadratic-weighted agreement by the chance agreement expected from marginal distributions, assigning a score of zero to a prevalence-only predictor.

KRPS比较了预测的和金的累积水平分布,KRPS i = 1 K − 1 k = 1 K − 1 K − 1 (F ^ i (k) − F i (k) ) 2,\mathrm{ KRPS}_{i}\i}\;=\;\;\frac {1}K-1}\sum_{k = 1}K-1}\bigl (\F}_{i}(k)-F_{i}(k)\bigr)^{2},(A1) 在每个不正确的水平上惩罚概率质量,而不只是定格值。 对于没有顺序的问题,没有累积结构,则省略。
QWK通过预期从边际分布得到的概率协议来折扣四重协议,将零分分配给一个只使用流行性的预测器.

blocks.en: Calibration is assessed at two complementary levels using ten equal-width bins (dropping empty bins): • Decision level: The top-label expected calibration error ( ECE ) Guo et al. (2017) evaluates the confidence of the argmax prediction: ECE = ∑ b n b N ​ | acc b − conf b | , \mathrm{ECE}\;=\;\sum_{b}\frac{n_{b}}{N}\,\bigl|\mathrm{acc}_{b}-\mathrm{conf}_{b}\bigr|, (A2) where n b n_{b} is the size of bin b b , and acc b \mathrm{acc}_{b} and conf b \mathrm{conf}_{b} are its accuracy and mean top-label confidence. • Distribution level: The multiclass Brier score ( BS ) Glenn and others (1950) is a proper scoring rule assessing the entire candidate distribution: BS = 1 N ​ ∑ i ∑ k ( p i ​ k − y i ​ k ) 2 , \mathrm{BS}\;=\;\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i}\sum_{k}\bigl(p_{ik}-y_{ik}\bigr)^{2}, (A3) with p i ​ k p_{ik} the predicted probability of candidate k k and y i ​ k y_{ik} its one-hot gold indicator. To disentangle miscalibration from discrimination, we apply the Murphy decomposition Murphy (1973) to its binned form: BS = REL − RES + UNC , \mathrm{BS}\;=\;\mathrm{REL}-\mathrm{RES}+\mathrm{UNC}, (A4) where the three terms are REL \displaystyle\mathrm{REL} = ∑ b w b ​ ( p ¯ b − y ¯ b ) 2 , \displaystyle=\sum_{b}w_{b}\,(\bar{p}_{b}-\bar{y}_{b})^{2}, (A5) RES \displaystyle\mathrm{RES} = ∑ b w b ​ ( y ¯ b − y ¯ ) 2 , \displaystyle=\sum_{b}w_{b}\,(\bar{y}_{b}-\bar{y})^{2}, UNC \displaystyle\mathrm{UNC} = y ¯ ​ ( 1 − y ¯ ) . \displaystyle=\bar{y}\,(1-\bar{y}). REL measures pure miscalibration (squared confidence–accuracy gap, lower is better), RES measures discrimination (spread of bin accuracies around the base rate, higher is better), and UNC is the data-intrinsic uncertainty independent of the model. The decomposition identity holds exactly for the binned score. The raw row-wise BS reported alongside differs from it only by a within-bin variance term. For multi-candidate questions, the decomposition is applied one-vs-rest per candidate, matching the multiclass BS projection whereas ECE targets the top-label decision. blocks.en: C.1 Qualitative Case Study
blocks.zh: C.1 定性案例研究

blocks.en: Figure A2 illustrates model behavior across both correct and incorrect predictions. On correct cases, Radev-2B consistently outputs decisive confidence (0.994 for an IID study without gallstones in (a); 0.993 for an external AMOS study with renal cysts in (b)), demonstrating that organ-grounded evidence supports reliable verdicts under both in-distribution and distribution-shifted settings. In contrast, baselines either hallucinate positive findings or remain uninformative near chance (e.g., Jev-1.14 at 0.540). Crucially, on a shared failure case where all three models miss a positive renal cyst (c), only Radev-2B’s confidence collapses to 0.062, effectively flagging its own error as unreliable. Meanwhile, GPT-5.4 provides no usable score and Jev-1.14 remains uninformative at 0.540, rendering neither error interceptable downstream. This demonstrates that Radev-2B not only errs less overall, but fails loudly: a simple confidence threshold would abstain on the erroneous case (c) while retaining the correct decisions in (a) and (b), converting silent failures into rejectable ones via selective prediction.
blocks.zh: 图A2说明了各种正确和不正确的预测的模型行为。 在正确的情况下,Radev-2B始终提供决定性的信心(0.994用于(a)中无胆石的ID研究;0.993用于(b)中含肾囊肿的外部AMOS研究),表明以器官为基础的证据支持在分配和分配转换环境下作出的可靠判断。 与此相对照,基线要么会产生阳性发现,要么在机会上保持不变(如Jev-1.14,0.540)。 关键是,对于一个所有三个模型都漏掉正肾囊肿(c)的共享失败案例,只有Redev-2B的信心崩溃到0.062,实际上将自己的错误标榜为不可靠。 同时,GPT-5.4不提供可用分数,Jev-1.14在0.540时仍无成形性,使得两个错误都无法下游拦截. 这表明,Radev-2B不仅在总体上没有犯错,而且严重失败:一个简单的信任阈值将会对错误案例(c)投弃权票,同时保留(a)和(b)中的正确决定,通过有选择的预测将沉默的失败转化为可拒绝的失败。
